summary: Frontend testing for the new PaletteSwitcher (24 curated themes replacing Sun/Moon toggle). All 12 frontend test scenarios from the review request PASS. The PaletteSwitcher is correctly mounted in the Topbar, legacy ThemeSwitcher is gone, the popover renders the expected title + 15 light + 9 dark swatches + Brand Studio link, palettes apply via inline CSS vars + data attributes + [data-surface='os'] style override (overrides the tenant theme as designed), values persist in localStorage 'mfd_curated_palette' across reloads, Escape and outside-click close the popover, the Brand Studio link routes to /settings/brand-studio, and the rose/cobalt/ivory palettes propagate correctly to Dashboard, Editorial Inbox, Billing/Plan, and International Presence pages with zero residual hardcoded-black cards. Backend was out of scope for this sprint.

minor.issue: Could not curl from test harness (403) because httpOnly cookies aren't propagated outside Playwright context. These endpoints work fine inside the authenticated SPA (verified by successful page rendering on /settings/plan, /editorial/inbox, /settings/international-presence). Not a regression.

critical_code_review_comments: applyPalette in curatedPalettes.js writes CSS variables BOTH on document.documentElement.style and inside a <style id='palette-switcher-os-overrides'> appended to <head>. This is a clean override strategy (relies on DOM order to win over TenantThemeContext), but documenting the contract explicitly with a code comment in TenantThemeContext.jsx would prevent future regressions if someone re-orders style-element creation.

getStoredPalette fallback returns 'ivory' for light and 'graphite' for dark based on legacy data-workspace-mode. Acceptable default but consider remembering the LAST-USED mode rather than always pinning to the namesake of each side.
Popover footer hint text is fine but no aria-describedby ties it to the dialog — minor a11y polish opportunity, not a blocker.
context_for_next_testing_agent:
Verified scenarios (all PASS):
  1. Topbar has [data-testid='palette-switcher-trigger']; legacy [data-testid='topbar-theme-switcher'] is absent.
  2. Click trigger -> [data-testid='palette-switcher-popover'] renders within <1.5s with title 'Temi curati', [data-testid='palette-section-light'] (15 swatches), [data-testid='palette-section-dark'] (9 swatches), [data-testid='palette-switcher-brand-studio'] href='/settings/brand-studio'.
  3. All 24 expected swatch ids present (ivory, linen, pearl, champagne, sand, sage, mint, sky, rose, lavender, peach, pistachio, coral, aqua, sunshine | graphite, midnight, obsidian, carbon, forest, burgundy, aubergine, slate, cobalt).
  4. Click rose -> data-palette='rose', data-palette-mode='light', --bp-bg=#F2E5E2.
  5. Click cobalt -> data-palette='cobalt', data-palette-mode='dark', --bp-bg=#080D1F.
  6. Click ivory -> --bp-bg=#F2ECE0 (exact match expected).
  7. localStorage['mfd_curated_palette']='rose' persists across reload; data-palette+--bp-bg remain after refresh.
  8. Brand Studio link navigates to https://.../settings/brand-studio.
  9. Escape closes popover, outside-click closes popover.
  10. Dashboard greeting H1 'Buona notte, Stefano.' renders in dark text on warm cream surface under ivory (high contrast, screenshot saved).
  11. /editorial/inbox, /settings/plan, /settings/international-presence all render with body bg = rgb(242,229,226) (#F2E5E2 rose paper) and ZERO hardcoded dark/black cards detected in DOM scan (scanned ~2000 elements per page looking for rgb(15,15,16)/rgb(0,0,0)/rgb(15,13,10) backgrounds on visible cards).
  12. Console error observed: 'Failed to load resource: 503' on dashboard occasionally during cold start — investigate if reproducible but did NOT block palette functionality.

The new palette switcher is solid, premium, and exactly matches the editorial 'tavolozza' described in the PR.
rca of the issue: No bugs found in this sprint.
